comment: * Represent the version of underlying vendor HAL service. * @see * HIDL versioning.

variables.name: UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment: The HAL Version indicating that the version is unsupported

variables.name: UNKNOWN
variables.comment: The HAL Version indicating that the version is unknown or invalid

methods.name: public boolean greater(HalVersion ver)
methods.comment: * @return True if the version is greater than the compared version.

methods.name: public boolean less(HalVersion ver)
methods.comment: * @return True if the version is less than the compared version.

methods.name: public boolean greaterOrEqual(HalVersion ver)
methods.comment: * @return True if the version is greater than or equal to the compared version.

methods.name: public boolean lessOrEqual(HalVersion ver)
methods.comment: * @return True if the version is less than or equal to the compared version.
